reviewer_notes: Contact sheet shows 24 generated 64px strips with six readable frames per row.
Blue and red melee/ranged/siege identities are visually distinct and match the requested dark MOBA faction palette.
South-east rows face diagonally toward screen-right/front; north-west rows face diagonally toward screen-left/back for the two-direction test.
Siege minions read as compact rune/rift crystal carts with rolling movement and cannon attack flashes.
